name: Guildmade Blade II
description: A weapon built to the wielder’s own spec, not whatever the smith happened to have on the rack.

name: Guildmade Band II
description: A ring cast and set by the guild’s own hand -- exactly the bonuses asked for, nothing left to chance.

name: Trail Rations
description: Smoked fish and dried herbs, packed for a hero who won’t be home for dinner.

name: Meal On The Go
description: Hearty, Meat n Veg stew. the perfect bowl of hot food for an adventurer

name: Herbal Tonic
description: The Herb Garden’s own cure-all, brewed in-house rather than bought off a vendor’s shelf.

name: Forager's Bundle
description: Wild berries and whatever else looked worth picking along the treeline -- more luck than skill in the gathering.

name: Pet Treat
description: Fish oil and dried herbs, worked into something a pet will actually want to eat -- a bigger happiness gain than raw scraps.

name: Beckoning Charm
description: Herbs and a little showmanship -- the Alchemist swears this is real, then winks in a way that undercuts the claim.

name: Guildmade Helm II
description: A helm shaped to one head, not sized to fit a rack of them.

name: Guildmade Plate II
description: Fitted plate, commissioned rather than pulled off a shop rack.

name: Guildmade Boots II
description: Broken in on the workshop floor before they ever see real ground.

name: Guildmade Cloak II
description: Cut and hemmed to the wearer's own height -- no guessing at the length.

name: Masterwork Warblade
description: Everything the guild's forges have learned, poured into one blade for one hero.

name: Masterwork Greathelm
description: No two are ever quite the same -- this one was never meant to be worn by anybody else.

name: Masterwork Plate
description: The guild's smiths call this one finished when they run out of ways to improve it.

name: Masterwork Gauntlets
description: Articulated at every knuckle -- a season's worth of fitting, for a single pair of hands.

name: Masterwork Sabatons
description: Weighted, balanced, and re-balanced again until the wearer stops noticing they're wearing them at all.

name: Masterwork Sigil
description: The guild's own mark, cast in gold and never sold -- every one of these was made to order.

name: Alchemist's Reserve
description: A stronger cure-all than the Herb Garden's basic tonic, brewed with a heavier hand.

name: Phoenix Ember
description: The Alchemist's best attempt at bottling something close to the real Phoenix Draught.

name: Warband Feast
description: A full spread cooked for a war party, packed down for one hero heading out alone.

name: Prospector's Cache
description: Ore and river silt, panned and pooled rather than bought outright.

name: Dragon's Hoard Charm
description: The Alchemist's own answer to Fortune's Bounty -- smells faintly of brimstone.

name: Lucky Charm (Gold)
description: A rough-cut charm worked at the bench rather than bought from the Alchemist's stock.

name: Lucky Charm (Insight)
description: A rough-cut charm worked at the bench rather than bought from the Alchemist's stock.

name: Fortune Weave (Gold)
description: Ore and herb worked into the same pull toward coin the Alchemist's own charms use.

name: Fortune Weave (Insight)

name: Windfall Sigil (Gold)
description: The Enchanter's own bench-made answer to the Alchemist's Greater Fortune Charm.

name: Windfall Sigil (Insight)
description: The Enchanter's own bench-made answer to the Alchemist's Greater Fortune Charm.
